//: The suites in tests/ import from src/main, src/shared and src/renderer, and until this file existed none of them were typechecked at all -- tsx strips types without checking them. That mattered more than it sounds: tests/services.ts carries a `satisfies Settings` annotation whose entire job is to break the build when a field is added to Settings and not named in the round-trip, and it could not, because nothing ever compiled it. The renderer's DOM types are in `lib` because tests/ui.ts drives the real DOMPurify through jsdom.
